ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels, approximately 70:30, with white dominating the medial surface and black concentrated on the marginal boundaries.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized contiguous white region spanning both lobes. The right lobe contains localized dark elliptical outlines and splotches. The trailing edges exhibit thick, irregular black marginal bands with higher density on the right lobe lateral tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an acute angle and significant bounding-box depth relative to the fluke horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations. Notable large-scale jagged indentations on the lateral-superior margin of the left lobe and multiple deep valleys along the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory on the lateral margins leading to sharply defined tips; the left lobe shows a steeper upward sweep than the right.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple dark circular/annular pixel clusters (ring-like markings) localized on the medial-distal region of the right lobe; sparse dark punctate spots on the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent vertical linear pigment disruption with an orange-brown hue located near the median notch; several fine, dark horizontal linear marks on the right lobe interior.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant tissue loss/irregular notch on the upper edge of the left lobe tip; extensive and deep trailing edge serrations suggesting mechanical interaction/trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized ferruginous (orange-toned) vertical stain near the fluke center notch.
